snippet.title: Marbella Vice Arcade (Castellano)
snippet.description:
The story is about a duo of cops who go to Marbella to stop a drug lord called "Amin Shala" and the criminal accomplices who are organizing for his return to Marbella.
Alex Angulo is your partner (like Spencer in Crime Patrol) who pops up frequently during the game. Catherine Fulop is the obligatory FMV babe. Santiago Segura is the police commissioner who nags you every time you get shot. 

The players have 3 skulls (lives) and are armed with an Uzi that shoots multiple projectiles by holding the trigger, every 2 seconds the game will autoreload a single bullet, you also get a single magazine bonus that will full reload the uzi, you get this every time you start a new run, or kill a certain amount of enemies.

The game takes place in 14 scenarios like hotels and casinos, every one of them is full of enemies and innocents (killing them will cost you a life), the pace of the game is very fast, so you need to react and shoot accordingly or you'll die, this makes the game pretty hard. At end of every single one them there is a cutscene.

It also features action chase sequences in cars, boats, and a helicopter, sometimes you cannot kill the enemies but instead you need to interact with the environment (something explosive to shoot in general) to proceed.

When you die, the game shows a newspaper that criticizes your actions and sometimes mocking the players or directly laugh at them.

The game supports two players local co-op. Thanks to @widge @LutherGond  and @DirtBagXon  for making this real.

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/InsertCoinArcadeOfficial/
Email: insertcoinarcade@outlook.it
